name: Katelyn Rose Downey
bio: Katelyn Rose Downey (born 15 February 2009) is an Irish actress.

credits.title: Bad Fairies
credits.overview: Hidden beneath the streets of modern London exists a secret magical world powered by an ancient code that fairies have followed for centuries. But when a fearless gang of rule-breaking fairies accidentally transforms an ordinary tween into a fairy, they uncover a far bigger problem: the magic system itself is failing.

credits.title: A Rare Breed
credits.overview: Hikers Mia and Erin come across a log cabin deep in the forest, where grizzled, enigmatic veteran Ray has taken a seemingly innocent young girl, Chloe, hostage. credits.title: Clodagh
credits.overview: A lonely priest's housekeeper discovers a young Irish girl of exceptional promise.

credits.title: The Nun II
credits.overview: In 1956 France, a priest is violently murdered, and Sister Irene begins to investigate. She once again comes face-to-face with a powerful evil.

credits.title: The Princess
credits.overview: A beautiful, strong-willed young royal refuses to wed the cruel sociopath to whom she is betrothed and is kidnapped and locked in a remote tower of her father’s castle. With her scorned, vindictive suitor intent on taking her father’s throne, the princess must protect her family and save the kingdom.
